v1AlignmentNote: v1.0 machine-readable model, v1.1 Option A expansion. Core: 52 entities + 96 relationships + 2 marker classes (MaintainedRecord, RiskSource). Assessment top-type polymorphism (Charter D14): 7 declared subclasses (DPIA, FRIA, LIA, TIA, PIA, AISIA, CompatibilityAssessment). Jurisdictional structure lifted to first-class core (Charter D12). R4C-12 resolved via ControlType attribute facet (Charter D15). 102 rework points (42 original L3→L4 + 26 v1.0 cross-cutting + 34 Option A per-domain expansion at L1→L2, L2→L3, L4→L5). Every rework point tagged with costCategory (structural-retrofit / spine-assembly / register-establishment / operational-automation / cross-cutting-declaration) per 4B §7.3.

domains.name: Processing Inventory
domains.description: The maintained register of processing activities — what processing happens, by which systems, on which data, for which purposes. The join hub of the whole model; structural choices here propagate furthest. Distinct from the RoPA report (Domain #12), which is a derived view.
domains.maturityNote: 6 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 3 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Purpose Specification & Governance
domains.description: The specification, governance, and lifecycle of processing purposes. Purposes are first-class registered entities; every activity has one or more; changes trigger downstream re-assessment. Domain #2 owns the purpose-compatibility test used by Domain #4.
domains.maturityNote: 4 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 1 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Personal Data Inventory & Classification
domains.description: The register of personal data categories, data elements, data subjects, and sensitivity classification. The Layer A source of truth for what data is in scope; feeds every other domain through personal-data-category and data-subject-category joins.
domains.maturityNote: 6 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 3 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Legal Basis Management
domains.description: The management of lawful bases for processing. LegalBasisAssignment is the reified per-(activity, purpose) binding; LIA, TIA, and CompatibilityAssessment attach as evidence artefacts. Cross-regime mapping is central here.
domains.maturityNote: 8 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 5 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Entities, Roles & Accountability
domains.description: The parties (Controller, Processor, Joint Controllers, Sub-Processors, Third Parties, Representatives, DPOs, Authorities) that take part in processing, and the accountability artefacts (DPAs, JCAs, Sub-Processor Authorisations, BCRs, SCCs) that evidence their bindings.
domains.maturityNote: 9 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 6 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Consent Management
domains.description: The maintained authoritative record of data subject consent — ConsentRecord (27560-aligned) plus append-only ConsentEvent stream. Bridges Layer A (purposes, personal data) to Layer B (notice, rights) through the consent-informed-link.
domains.maturityNote: 6 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 3 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Data Subject Rights Management
domains.description: The operational handling of data subject rights requests across their lifecycle — intake, verification, scoping, fulfilment, notification, appeal. RightExerciseRecord aggregates the sub-activities; per-jurisdiction timers govern deadlines.
domains.maturityNote: 6 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 3 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Notice & Transparency
domains.description: The cross-domain artefact pattern for transparency — abstract Notice parent plus versioning substrate (NoticeVersion, NoticePresentation, NoticeDelivery). Concrete notice subtypes (consent, breach, legal-basis) are co-owned by their triggering domains.
domains.maturityNote: 7 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 4 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Risk & Impact Assessment
domains.description: The assessment of risks to data subjects (and organisation) from processing activities. Polymorphic Assessment top-type (renamed from ImpactAssessment at v1.0) with DPIA / FRIA / LIA / TIA / PIA / AISIA / CompatibilityAssessment subclasses; RiskSource marker disambiguates risk-generating from risk-observing entities.
domains.maturityNote: 10 rework points (1 L1→L2, 2 L2→L3, 6 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Technical & Organisational Measures
domains.description: The catalogue of technical, organisational, legal, and physical controls that mitigate risk. Control + Mitigation reification; at v1.0, R4C-12 is resolved via ControlType attribute facet (Charter D15). SoA, EffectivenessReview attach as maintained records.
domains.maturityNote: 8 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 5 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Incident & Breach Management
domains.description: The lifecycle handling of personal-data breaches and wider privacy/security incidents — Incident register, per-regime Notifications, RecipientAuthority binding. At v1.0 gains Deadline and Complaint entities; jurisdictional cluster attaches for cross-regime breach-notification obligations.
domains.maturityNote: 6 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 3 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Regulatory Reporting & Disclosure
domains.description: The view-derivation machinery that projects maintained-truth inventories into regulator-submitted artefacts. Eight-construct catalogue (Catalogue, TemplateProfile, FieldDefinition, MappingRule, SubmissionSnapshot, SubmissionLedger, EvidenceRecord, SubmissionChain).
domains.maturityNote: 5 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 2 L3→L4, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

domains.name: Technology & AI Governance
domains.description: Interface-only scope for the Technology and AI worlds — the minimum entity/relationship set needed to reach TechSystem, AISystem, AIModel, Dataset. Deeper AI-governance modelling (technique/capability taxonomies, Annex IV documentation, model/system/data cards) is deferred to a dedicated future model.
domains.maturityNote: 3 rework points (1 L1→L2, 1 L2→L3, 1 L4→L5) per v1.0 maturity-delta catalogue.

entities.name: ProcessingActivity
entities.definition: A unit of processing — what is performed, on which personal data, for which purposes, by which parties. The join hub of the maintained spine.

entities.name: Purpose
entities.definition: A specified, explicit, legitimate intent for which processing is conducted. First-class registered entity with IRI, label, definition.

entities.name: PersonalDataCategory
entities.definition: A taxonomic class of personal data (e.g., contact, biometric, financial). Multi-parent DAG via skos:broader.

entities.name: DataElement
entities.definition: A first-class instance entity representing the controller's specific data, distinct from category. Linked to PersonalDataCategory via inCategory.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: DataSubject
entities.definition: A natural person to whom personal data relates.

entities.name: DataSubjectCategory
entities.definition: A first-class wrapper for a category of data subjects (e.g., customers, employees, prospects, minors).

entities.name: Party
entities.definition: The base entity for any actor: organisation, individual, public body, international organisation.

entities.name: PartyRoleInActivity
entities.definition: An association class binding a Party to a ProcessingActivity with a typed role drawn from the abstract PartyRole taxonomy (Controller / Processor / JointController / Recipient / ThirdParty / DataSubject / Representative / DataProtectionOfficer).

entities.name: PartyRole
entities.definition: The abstract typing for a role a Party plays in an Activity. Concrete instances (DataController, DataProcessor, etc.) are DPV-adopted; regime-specific specialisations attach via profile.

entities.name: RecipientCategory
entities.definition: A first-class wrapper for a category of recipients (e.g., service providers, public authorities, marketing partners).

entities.name: LegalBasis
entities.definition: The abstract typing for a lawful basis. The class has no concrete members at the core; regime-specific instances (eu-gdpr:Consent, ccpa:BusinessPurpose, ...) are profile-contributed.

entities.name: LegalBasisAssignment
entities.definition: An association class binding a ProcessingActivity (and/or Purpose) to a LegalBasis, carrying effective dates, status, evidence references, party attribution, and previousAssignment chain.

entities.name: StatutoryClauseInstance
entities.definition: A first-class instance of a clause in a legal corpus, the citation anchor for any LegalBasisAssignment (and other regime-bound artefacts). Each instance lives in a profile namespace.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: ConsentRecord
entities.definition: The maintained authoritative record of a data subject's consent for a specific processing context. Jurisdiction-neutral structure aligned with ISO/IEC TS 27560:2023.

entities.name: ConsentEvent
entities.definition: An append-only event recording a state transition in the consent lifecycle (given / refused / withdrawn / expired / reaffirmed). Authoritative form of the consent state machine.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: RightExerciseRecord
entities.definition: The aggregated record of a data subject's rights-exercise, comprising 1..N activities.

entities.name: RightExerciseActivity
entities.definition: A typed sub-step of rights handling (receipt / verification / scoping / decision / notification / appeal).

entities.name: Right
entities.definition: The abstract typing for a data-subject right. Concrete rights (gdpr:RightOfAccess, ccpa:RightToKnow-SpecificPieces, ...) are profile-contributed.

entities.name: Assessment
entities.definition: The top-level abstract parent for all assessment artefacts a privacy program produces. Extensible — currently declared with seven polymorphic impact-flavoured subtypes (DPIA, FRIA, LIA, TIA, PIA, AISIA, CompatibilityAssessment) and open to future subtypes for compliance, risk, and other assessment families. Each subtype's concrete field schema is contributed by the applicable regulation profile.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: Risk
entities.definition: A unified node that plays Risk / RiskSource / Threat / Consequence / Impact roles via the predicate it appears under (post-#181 role-as-relation pattern).

entities.name: Consequence
entities.definition: A typed outcome of a Risk materialising, a node in the Risk-graph.

entities.name: Impact
entities.definition: A typed end-state experienced by a Party (typically a DataSubject) when a Consequence materialises.

entities.name: Control
entities.definition: The atomic mitigation unit — technical, organisational, legal, or physical (Technical or Organisational Measure).

entities.name: Mitigation
entities.definition: An association class binding a Control to a Risk (or Consequence) with coverage, strength, and residual-delta.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: Incident
entities.definition: The canonical event entity for a personal-data breach or wider privacy/security incident. One canonical entity with N regime-typed Notification projections.

entities.name: Notification
entities.definition: A typed notification of an Incident (or other obligation) to a recipient — a regulatory authority, an affected data subject, or another recipient category.

entities.name: RecipientAuthority
entities.definition: A typed Party that receives a Notification in its capacity as supervisory / sectoral / market-surveillance / CSIRT authority.

entities.name: AccountabilityArtefact
entities.definition: The unifying abstract parent for the family of regulated-relationship artefacts: DPA, JointControllerArrangement, ProcessorAuthorisation, RepresentativeDesignation, DPODesignation, ConsentRecord, NoticeVersion, Assessment (and its subtypes: DPIA, FRIA, LIA, TIA, PIA, AISIA, CompatibilityAssessment), StatementOfApplicability, EvidenceRecord.

entities.name: Notice
entities.definition: An abstract transparency artefact disclosing processing information. Concrete subtypes (PrivacyNotice, ConsentNotice, IncidentNotice, RightFulfilmentNotice) are co-owned by triggering domains via the cross-domain artefact pattern.

entities.name: NoticeVersion
entities.definition: An immutable versioned snapshot of a Notice, with effectiveFrom, supersedes, materialChangeFlag. The 'informed-link' target for ConsentRecord.

entities.name: TechSystem
entities.definition: A technology system used to perform processing. Interface-only per Domain #13 stance.

entities.name: AISystem
entities.definition: An AI system (specialisation / peer of TechSystem). Interface-only carrying isHighRisk, isGPAI, lifecycleStage.

entities.name: AIModel
entities.definition: An ML model trained on data, used by AISystems.

entities.name: Dataset
entities.definition: A bounded collection of personal data instances aggregated for AI training / validation / testing.

entities.name: RetentionRule
entities.definition: A per-(activity, data-category) retention rule. Free-text at L2; typed entity binding to PersonalDataCategory at L3.

entities.name: MaintenanceStatus
entities.definition: A universal five-state status (draft / approved / active / under-review / archived) applied to any MaintainedRecord. Introduced at L2; mandatory at L3.

entities.name: AttestationRecord
entities.definition: A per-review attestation carrying signed-off-by (Party), attestation date, evidence reference, and any reviewer commentary. Attached to a MaintainedRecord as part of periodic review discipline.

entities.name: CompatibilityAssessment
entities.definition: An assessment of the compatibility of a further-processing purpose with the original purpose of collection, under GDPR Art. 6(4) or analogue. Polymorphic subtype of Assessment.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: PurposeStatus
entities.definition: Lifecycle states for Purpose: draft / active / deprecated / retired.

entities.name: ClassificationAssignment
entities.definition: A reified DataElement→sensitivity assignment carrying assertedBy, assertedAt, and effective dates.

entities.name: IdentityStateTransition
entities.definition: A reified event recording a DataElement's identifiability transition (identified → pseudonymised → anonymised).

entities.name: TransferEvent
entities.definition: A cross-border data transfer event. Profile-bound (GDPR Chapter V) with dual-axis legal basis (Art. 6 + Chapter V).

entities.name: SCCInstance
entities.definition: An instance of Standard Contractual Clauses governing a transfer. Profile-bound to GDPR Art. 46(2)(c)-(d).

entities.name: LegitimateInterestsAssessment
entities.definition: A Legitimate Interests Assessment evidencing the three-step test (legitimate purpose / necessity / balancing) required under GDPR Art. 6(1)(f). Polymorphic subtype of Assessment.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: TransferImpactAssessment
entities.definition: A Transfer Impact Assessment evidencing the six-step EDPB 01/2020 test for cross-border personal-data transfers under GDPR Chapter V. Polymorphic subtype of Assessment.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)
entities.maturity: L3+ when Chapter V tool used

entities.name: DataProcessingAgreement
entities.definition: A controller-processor contract governing data processing under GDPR Art. 28(3), HIPAA BAA, LGPD operator contract, etc.

entities.name: JointControllerArrangement
entities.definition: A joint-controller arrangement under GDPR Art. 26 or analogues, allocating responsibilities between joint controllers.

entities.name: RoleFlipEvent
entities.definition: A reified event recording a Party's role mutation under Art. 28(10) GDPR (processor acting beyond instructions becomes controller).
entities.statusDetail: periphery-risk (option chosen per organisational risk tolerance)

entities.name: Enterprise
entities.definition: A GDPR Art. 4(18) undertaking as the Art. 83 fine-calculation unit. Risk-discretionary (R4C-37).
entities.statusDetail: periphery-risk (option chosen per organisational risk tolerance)

entities.name: GroupOfUndertakings
entities.definition: A BCR scope-of-undertakings entity. Risk-discretionary (R4C-36); multinational-only.
entities.statusDetail: periphery-risk (option chosen per organisational risk tolerance)

entities.name: ConsentReceipt
entities.definition: The data-subject-facing record of a consent submission, aligned with ISO/IEC TS 27560:2023.

entities.name: ParentalAuthoriser
entities.definition: A parent or guardian authorising processing of a child's data under GDPR Art. 8, COPPA §6502(b), or DPDPA §9.

entities.name: Appeal
entities.definition: An appeal of a rights-request decision. Generic at the core; regime-specific specialisations attach via profile.

entities.name: JurisdictionTimerPolicy
entities.definition: A per-jurisdiction lookup that determines whether identity-verification doubt pauses or restarts the response timer. Risk-discretionary (R4C-31).
entities.statusDetail: periphery-risk (option chosen per organisational risk tolerance)

entities.name: NoticeItem
entities.definition: A typed atomic item disclosed by a Notice (e.g., controller-identity, purpose, retention period, recipient categories).

entities.name: LayeredPresentation
entities.definition: WP203 three-tier presentation (shortLabel / definition / detailedDescription). Used by Notice and Purpose.

entities.name: NoticeDelivery
entities.definition: A reified per-subject, per-version notice-delivery event with channel binding and acknowledgement state.

entities.name: DataProtectionImpactAssessment
entities.definition: A Data Protection Impact Assessment, required for high-risk processing under GDPR Art. 35 (or analogue in LGPD, DPDPA). Polymorphic subtype of Assessment.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: FundamentalRightsImpactAssessment
entities.definition: A Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment under EU AI Act Art. 27 (or analogue in emerging AI-governance regimes). Polymorphic subtype of Assessment.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)
entities.maturity: L3+ when high-risk AI in use

entities.name: PrivacyImpactAssessment
entities.definition: A Privacy Impact Assessment; the general-purpose superset that DPIA and FRIA specialise from. Used directly in jurisdictions that require impact assessment without a GDPR-style specific structure (US-federal, some US-state regimes).
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: Complaint
entities.definition: A complaint made against a controller or processor about their privacy practices, whether by a data subject, a regulator, or another party. Includes GDPR Art. 77 supervisory-authority complaints, Art. 12(4) data-subject complaints, and equivalents in other regimes.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: TrainingRecord
entities.definition: A record of privacy-training completion by a Party (typically staff), including completion date, training programme identifier, and any assessment result. Supports GDPR Art. 39(1)(b) / analogous training-audit obligations.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: RetentionRule
entities.definition: A retention rule specifying the period a record must be kept, the disposal trigger event, and any applicable exceptions. Attached to a ProcessingActivity or a PersonalDataCategory via ref:hasRetentionRule.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: OptOutSignal
entities.definition: A machine-readable opt-out signal (GPC, ADPC, DAA opt-out, and analogous) captured by a ConsentEvent as evidence of universal-opt-out honour under US state laws.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: ControlType
entities.definition: The typed classification of a Control (Technical, Organisational, Legal, Physical, per ISO/IEC 27002:2022). R4C-12 resolves in favour of attribute facet: control types are values via ref:hasControlType, not subclasses of ref:Control.
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: RegulationProfile
entities.definition: A regulation-specific overlay on the regulation-agnostic core. Attaches mandatory-field overlays, regime-typed concept instances, projection views, and cross-regime mappings to the core spine, enabling multi-regime composition.

entities.name: AISystemImpactAssessment
entities.definition: An AI System Impact Assessment covering algorithmic and system-level risks distinct from the fundamental-rights lens of FRIA. Framework-specific (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42005).
entities.statusDetail: core-extended (declared at core; structured at L3+)

entities.name: StatementOfApplicability
entities.definition: An ISO 27001 / 27701 Statement of Applicability listing applicable controls, justification, and implementation status.

entities.name: EffectivenessReview
entities.definition: A reified periodic review of Control effectiveness under Art. 32(1)(d) GDPR or analogue. C8 in DPVCG contribution package.

entities.name: SeverityAssessment
entities.definition: An ENISA-methodology severity assessment of an Incident's likely impact.

entities.name: NearMiss
entities.definition: A first-class near-miss event class. Risk-discretionary (R4C-34); first-class at L4+.
entities.statusDetail: periphery-risk (option chosen per organisational risk tolerance)

entities.name: NotificationObligation
entities.definition: A cross-regime lookup specifying notification timer, threshold, recipient type, and content per applicable regime. C9 in DPVCG contribution package (DPV issue #282).

entities.name: TemplateProfile
entities.definition: A view-derivation primary entity binding a (regime, audience, time-phase) tuple to a set of FieldDefinitions and MappingRules. C12 in DPVCG contribution package.

entities.name: SubmissionSnapshot
entities.definition: A reified immutable as-of-time projection-view binding submission content to source records at a fixed timestamp. C12 in DPVCG contribution package.

entities.name: SubmissionLedger
entities.definition: An EDPB-style ledger of regulator submissions, used to demonstrate accountability via append-only history.

entities.name: SubmissionChain
entities.definition: A linkage of phased reports (e.g., GDPR Art. 33(4) initial → supplementary breach notifications).

entities.name: Location
entities.definition: A geographic place or region. Locations form a containment DAG through skos:broader (e.g., Quebec → Canada → North America); roll-up queries use ?loc skos:broader* ?ancestor so a query at any level returns subjects located at or below that level.

entities.name: Jurisdiction
entities.definition: A legal-regime scoped area within which a regulation applies or under which a Party operates. Jurisdictions may form a containment DAG through skos:broader (e.g., California → United States). Extraterritorial scopes are supported (EU + Art. 3(2)). Distinct from Location: a Jurisdiction is a legal concept, not a geographic one.

entities.name: TransferMechanism
entities.definition: The legal mechanism under which personal data is transferred across jurisdictions (GDPR Chapter V, LGPD Chapter V, CCPA §1798.145). Abstract class; concrete instances are contributed by regulation profiles (e.g., dpv-gdpr:StandardContractualClauses, dpv-gdpr:AdequacyDecision).

entities.name: MaintainedRecord
entities.definition: Marker class (Charter D13). Typing hook that applies the universal maintenance/freshness cluster (hasMaintenanceStatus, hasAttestation, lastReviewedOn, nextReviewDue) to any register-shaped entity. Sibling extension to the ReifiedAssociation pattern.
entities.statusDetail: marker-class (universal typing hook, v1.0 addition per Charter D13)

entities.name: RiskSource
entities.definition: Marker class (Charter D13). Typing hook that disambiguates risk-generating entities (source, hazard, vulnerability) from risk-observing entities (Assessment, RiskEvaluation). Applied to HighRiskFactor and per-domain risk classes in #3/#9/#11/#13.
entities.statusDetail: marker-class (universal typing hook, v1.0 addition per Charter D13)

relationships.name: hasAttestationRecord
relationships.obligation: Optional at L3, Mandatory at L4+

relationships.name: ownedByParty
relationships.obligation: Conditional in core, Mandatory at L3+

decisions.title: Processing Inventory primary entity
decisions.recommendation: Activity-centric with attached System reference (D_PE_01)
decisions.options: activity-centric (Art. 30) / system-centric (NIST P1) / container-agnostic recursive (DPV Process nesting)

decisions.title: Granularity unit on Processing Activity
decisions.recommendation: Per-(activity, purpose) with refinements for special-category and transfer (D_CARD_04)
decisions.options: per-activity row / per-purpose row / per-(activity, purpose) row / per-(activity, purpose, data-category) row

decisions.title: Recursive nesting of ProcessingActivity
decisions.recommendation: Recursive nesting permitted; flat at L1-L2
decisions.options: flat activity rows / DPV-style recursive nesting (sub-process composition)

decisions.title: Rights canonical entity
decisions.recommendation: Record-of-activities with derived rolled-up status at L1-L2 (D_PE_08, D_REIF_05)
decisions.options: request-with-status (ICO SAR log shape) / RightExerciseRecord of activities (DPV shape)

decisions.title: Consent canonical representation
decisions.recommendation: Immutable event-stream as authoritative, with derived current-status + optional per-material-change versioned ConsentRecord (D_LIFE_01)
decisions.options: mutable-status Consent record / immutable ConsentEvent stream / versioned ConsentRecord chain

decisions.title: Consent lifecycle granularity unit
decisions.recommendation: Per-Purpose default; per-(Purpose, Recipient) where recipient set is rich
decisions.options: per-Process / per-Purpose / per-(Purpose, Recipient)

decisions.title: ConsentRecord profile selection
decisions.recommendation: Canonical 27560 with regime profile overlays per Phase 4A.5
decisions.options: canonical 27560 / GDPR-bound dpv-27560:record-eu-gdpr / regime-specific (CCPA, LGPD, DPDPA)

decisions.title: Risk modelling structure
decisions.recommendation: Graph with DPV-RISK post-issue-#181 role-as-relation pattern (D_RAR_01, D_PE_10)
decisions.options: single Risk entity with attributes / graph of distinct entities (RiskSource/Threat/Consequence/Impact/Risk)

decisions.title: Risk-taxonomy primary axis
decisions.recommendation: Rights-based primary with crosswalks to CIA / harm / threat-actor (D_SP_11)
decisions.options: rights-based (GDPR Art. 35(7)(c), AI Act 27) / CIA-based (security-led) / harm-based (NIST PRAM) / threat-actor-based

decisions.title: Risk-scale type
decisions.recommendation: Ordinal default; semi-quantitative at L3+; quantitative at L4+ optional
decisions.options: ordinal / semi-quantitative / quantitative (FAIR-style probability distributions)

decisions.title: DPIA / TIA / FRIA polymorphism depth
decisions.recommendation: Polymorphic with kind discriminator (D_PE_10)
decisions.options: parallel-sibling entities / polymorphic ImpactAssessment parent with kind discriminator / single DPIA with content variation

decisions.title: TOM theme: class or attribute facet
decisions.recommendation: RESOLVED v1.0 via Charter D15: ControlType attribute facet (5.3a in 4A). Attribute facet, with the ISO/IEC 27002:2022 five-attribute taxonomy (D_FACET_01, D_FACET_02, D_RAR_04)
decisions.options: hierarchical class taxonomy (Technical/Organisational/Legal/Physical as classes) / attribute facet (controlTheme on unified Control)

decisions.title: Control catalogue shape
decisions.recommendation: Flat-with-attributes defensible up to L3; L4+ requires interoperability with STRM-style cross-walks
decisions.options: flat-with-attributes / base + enhancement (NIST 800-53) / matrix (CCM) / polyhierarchy (DPV TOM)

decisions.title: Privacy-control integration mode
decisions.recommendation: Converging toward integrated as 27701:2025 pulls the marketplace; separation defensible where infosec and privacy programmes have distinct ownership
decisions.options: separate-but-integrated / extending (ISO 27701-on-27001) / standalone (27701:2025) / integrated

decisions.title: Control role-conditioned applicability mode
decisions.recommendation: Both supported; choice depends on organisation role mix
decisions.options: role-conditioned (27701 mode: Annex A controller / Annex B processor) / role-neutral catalogue with applicability-by-attribute (NIST mode)

decisions.title: PersonalData taxonomy choice
decisions.recommendation: DPV-PD imported with provenance-facet extension
decisions.options: DPV-PD imported / custom internal taxonomy crosswalked to DPV-PD

decisions.title: Sensitivity scheme depth
decisions.recommendation: Multi-axis at L3+; intrinsic-only acceptable at L1-L2 (D_CAT_05, D_FACET_03)
decisions.options: single scheme (CIA-like ordinal) / multi-axis (Category x Sensitivity x Legal-status x Provenance x Identity-state)

decisions.title: Data-element tier depth
decisions.recommendation: Categories only L1-L2; LogicalDataElement at L3; PhysicalField at L4 (D_CAT_06)
decisions.options: category-only (one tier) / two-tier (LogicalDataElement + Category) / three-tier (PhysicalField + LogicalDataElement + Category)

decisions.title: Intrinsic vs intrinsic-plus-contextual sensitivity storage
decisions.recommendation: Both - intrinsic stored, contextual computed at L3+ (D_FACET_03)
decisions.options: intrinsic only / intrinsic stored + contextual computed

decisions.title: Sub-processor chain depth representation
